before: Charts are read-only. No command writes a chart part or an embedded workbook, and a chart frame refuses resize, move, and wrap.
after: insertChart writes a new chart part, an embedded workbook, and their relationships. setChartData, setChartType, setChartFormat, and setChartColor replace the chart part and the workbook. A chart that is not in mc:AlternateContent takes resizeDrawing, positionDrawing, setDrawingWrap, and setDrawingMetadata, as a picture does. A chart paste copies the chart part and the parts it reaches as new parts, adds a chart relationship, and inserts the drawing, in one package unit. A drag of a floating drawing to another body paragraph sends deleteDrawing and insertDrawing in one transaction, with the new position on the inserted drawing.
reason: The commands use the existing package operations: new XML and binary parts, relationships, and same-identity node replacement. A chart frame edit writes the same drawing extent, position, and wrap nodes as a picture frame edit. Peers on older versions receive ordinary part and node changes. No shared field or operation changes. A chart paste uses the same part, relationship, and insertDrawing operations as insertChart. The move of an anchor uses only the existing deleteDrawing and insertDrawing operations.
